title: Care Plan Credit on Therapy Visit Copays
content:
## Care plan credit — Medicaid Managed Care Membership therapy courses

**Clause.** The re-rated copay of a rehabilitation therapy course visit is lowered by a care plan credit that follows care management: where the member enrolled in a care management episode during the therapy window and signed a care plan version in the window, the credit is the signed care plan credit of 0.50 USD; where the member enrolled in such an episode without signing a care plan version in the window, the credit is the unsigned care plan credit of 0.25 USD; otherwise there is no care plan credit.

The care plan credit is subtracted from the re-rated copay of each course visit that is neither an intake visit nor an extension visit, and that copay, after the credits subtracted from it, is never below zero.

## Records read

- **Enrolled during the therapy window:** a Care Management episode whose enrollment date falls in the therapy window, the 12 months counted back from the review date.
- **Signed a care plan version in the window:** a care plan update on the Care Management record, marked as signed by the member, with an activity date in the therapy window.

## Truth table

| Episode enrolled in the window | Care plan version signed in the window | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.50 USD |
| Yes | No | 0.25 USD |
| No | Yes | none |
| No | No | none |

An episode enrolled before the therapy window began does not count as enrolled during it, even where it is still open.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A course visit whose re-rated copay is 2.00 USD, for a member who enrolled in an episode in the window and signed a care plan version in it, is lowered by 0.50 USD to 1.50 USD.
